description: Hello! My name is Konouz and I'm forming a super duper awesome team to help create something impactful! I am deeply passionate about space, astronomy, and creating cool software using code. In this challenge we will be tackling the very difficult but rewarding problem of mapping a huge space dataset into comprehensible visualizations via a web interface to make it easier for regular folks and also scientists to make sense of new data. If you like winning, learning, and having fun, join my team!
